checks.name: All program orders produce the same complete dispatch and refund
Two dispatches from the same snapshot cannot oversell in either arrival order
Counter deltas from two packing lines with the same SKU sum rather than overwrite
Arbitrary new SKU participates without any renderer or reaction change
Duplicate event identity cannot partially reserve stock or spend funds
Different field stale edits commute; same field stale edits preserve a conflict
Overlapping handler intent refuses atomically with both proposals
Disjoint authors may edit the same view; disagreement never uses file order
Same-priority styling disagreement stays visible, explicit precedence works
Missing structure targets and graph cycles are diagnosed
Replay from persisted state preserves dispatch and exact refunds
